title: ‘Bad Mom’ Realizes She’s Getting Arrested
description:
Brian and Sara Wilks, visiting Florida from Houston, Texas, left their 6-month-old daughter unattended on Miramar Beach in Walton County for nearly an hour while walking with their other three children. Watch as deputies investigate and make arrests on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
